summary.zh: 优化应用内付费墙与升级弹窗的转化
summary.en: Improve in-app paywall and upgrade modal conversion

description.zh: 针对应用内付费墙、升级弹窗、功能门禁和试用到期页，按用户已获得价值的时机调整文案、权益呈现和按钮层级。适合订阅转化偏低或改版升级流程时使用。
description.en: Improves in-app paywalls, upgrade modals, feature gates and trial-expiry screens by matching copy, offer framing and hierarchy to the moment a user has felt value. Use it when upgrades lag or the flow is being redesigned.
